reason: The named lab and the report behind the QR code are what get me, I almost never see that on TikTok Shop. At $24.99 for the first box it is an easy impulse buy and I can money-back it if I don't like it.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule? And Made in China makes me want to see that lab report is real.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video showing the real lab report for a batch, or a clear reason why bisglycinate alone beats the multi-form blends.
